answer: Like a stone jetty fracturing an ocean swell, proof-of-interaction graphs anchor consensus against synthetic floods. Every genuine transaction is a delicate whisper between nodes, while a Sybil swarm forms an abrupt, turbulent plume. By enforcing quadratic staking on edge creation, the network creates a superlinear attacker cost: multiplying pseudonymous identities exponentially drains capital before their false resonance can sway the tide.
